Changes (See "changes.txt" for full list):

  • Fixed issue where some tasks are not disabled on some systems
  • Fixed issue where some registry keys do not update on some systems
  • Added option to disable Windows Update

Broken Tasks:

On some systems, Ancile was not changing the values of some registry entries and was failing to disable some tasks. Running this version of Ancile will fix this issue.

New Configuration Option:

You can now choose to completely disable Windows Update. If both "MODWINUPDATE" and "DISABLEWINUPDATE" are enabled, Ancile will set Windows update to; do NOT check for updates, do NOT download updates, do NOT install updates, and it will disable the Windows Update service.

This option can be found in "config.ini"

# DISABLEWINUPDATE (Boolean) - If MODWINUPDATE is enabled, Disable Windows Update.
# Y - Disable Windows Update. Do not check, Do not Download, Do not install, disable update service.
# N - Enable Windows Update to follow MODWINUPDATE behavior (DEFAULT).
DISABLEWINUPDATE=N
